dialogues.speaker: Chanil
dialogues.text: When will I be able to bring a Saurian home...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to raise one?

dialogues.speaker: Chanil
dialogues.text: Yes, I do! I really want to, even in my dreams!

dialogues.speaker: Chanil
dialogues.text: But Mom and Dad keep telling me that I'm still too young, and that I'll have to earn some kind of special name before I can bring a Saurian home...

dialogues.speaker: Chanil
dialogues.text: Why? I really don't get it. Don't I already have a name of my own? Is it because the Saurians can't understand the way we talk, so we've got to use their language instead?

dialogues.speaker: Chanil
dialogues.text: *sigh* When will I finally be considered a grown-up? I just want to be able to cuddle with my Saurian as I eat and fall asleep...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You'll be able to one day.

dialogues.speaker: Chanil
dialogues.text: Really? Ah, but I'll be a lot happier if I don't have to wait so long...

dialogues.speaker: Chanil
dialogues.text: I know, I know! I've taken nearly all the baby Saurians in the tribe home at one point or another.

dialogues.speaker: Chanil
dialogues.text: But none of them was able to stay for too long... They all returned to their partners sooner than later.

dialogues.speaker: Chanil
dialogues.text: Actually, now that you mention it, I don't think any of their grown-up partners had any kind of fancy name...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe they've got something they need to work together on.

dialogues.speaker: Chanil
dialogues.text: Is that so? Well, in that case, should I not stop making a ruckus, and instead wait patiently for their return?

dialogues.speaker: Chanil
dialogues.text: I've got it. I'll prepare some snacks for them next time. I want all the little Saurians to know that my house is a good place for them to relax!

dialogues.speaker: Chanil
dialogues.text: C'mon, you take some too. If you spot any lil' Saurians having a roadside rest, do share it with them.
